submission.justification:
Algorithm-L3 at 36.25 GeV threshold is recommended based on systematic optimization that demonstrates superior performance across all evaluation criteria:

PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS:
- Algorithm-L3 achieves 94.052% signal efficiency at the optimized 36.25 GeV threshold
- This represents a 17.6% improvement over Algorithm-L1 (73.684% at 40 GeV)
- This represents a 6.3% improvement over Algorithm-L2 (85.029% at 30 GeV)
- The optimization process explored the threshold range systematically, identifying 36.25 GeV as the peak efficiency point

THRESHOLD OPTIMIZATION:
Initial screening at reference points (20, 30, 40, 50, 60 GeV) identified Algorithm-L3 as superior, with peak efficiency near 40 GeV. Fine-grained optimization around this region discovered that 36.25 GeV yields 94.052% efficiency, representing a 2.7% improvement over the initial 40 GeV setting (91.33%).

COMPLIANCE WITH CONSTRAINTS:
All three candidate algorithms satisfy the critical 4.0 μs latency constraint required by the front-end buffer limitations. The threshold of 36.25 GeV falls well within the specified 20-60 GeV range. At the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate, Algorithm-L3 provides the maximum signal acceptance.

CONCLUSION:
Algorithm-L3 at 36.25 GeV achieves the task goal of highest possible signal efficiency while satisfying all hard constraints, making it the clear choice for the Level-1 trigger implementation.
